records.definition: The remote main branch is the accepted-state ledger. It is read through exact detached snapshots and written through separate detached main transactions, not by mutating the ordinary checkout.
A local Git checkout used as a repository handle. It may be dirty or stale and is deliberately not the execution or acceptance workspace.
Kernel-backed cross-process coordination for local Git ref/object/worktree mutation, owned by an ooRexx lifecycle object with a flock(2) holder.
Transport-neutral local package root plus source provenance; requires package-root integration.json.
Package-root declarative identity, exact dependencies, test/environment contract and publication intent.
Manifest package.name@package.version when integration.json exists; directory spelling is not authoritative.
Legacy identity derivation used only when integration.json is absent.
Exact package-root availability map consumed by planning; bootstrap availability is not acceptance.
Resolved per-package plan containing exact dependency roots and planned tests with argv/cwd/timeout/environment.
Base environment, dependency entries, package environment, then test environment; later layers may prepend/append/replace as declared.
autobuild-submit/<submission-id> transport envelope carrying package body then ready marker; never merged into accepted main.
Immutable Git submission go-marker committed after the package body.
Exact Git tree object for autobuild/inbox/<id>/package used to deduplicate/conflict-check a submission identity.
autobuild/receipts/<submission-id>.json; terminal idempotency evidence that suppresses reprocessing.
Durable run evidence containing source, package, publication, per-test status, bounded environment and log paths.
Versioned immutable local copy of Alchemy Core packages/tools used by the resident systemd service.
Existing accepted target with different content; a hard error rather than overwrite.
Ledger semantics stating that dependency seeding establishes availability only.
Development source checkpoint before RC qualification; never equivalent to an accepted runtime release.
Alchemy Objects readiness level requiring BASE plus purpose, package version, authorship, implemented standards and explicit design limitations metadata.
